chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr asked al-Ridha (peace be upon him):
About a man who marries a woman in temporary marriage (mut'ah), is it permissible for him to marry her daughter permanently? He said: "No."
ai.seo_question: Can a man who married a woman in temporary marriage marry her daughter permanently?
ai.summary: Imam al-Ridha (peace be upon him) clarified that the prohibition of marrying the daughter of a temporary wife is absolute, preventing a man from marrying her 'in one go' (batatan) as a permanent spouse. This ruling underscores the distinct legal status of mut'ah in Shia jurisprudence, where the temporary bond creates specific kinship ties (mahramiyah) that persist even after the contract expires, thereby barring permanent marriage to her daughter.
